title: Large Furnished 1 Bedroom
desc:
Small, quiet building in the West End. Just 3 blocks from the beach and one block off Davie. Close to shopping, clubs, bars, and grocery stores. Furnished with a full kitchen, living room and bedroom. It could also come unfurnished if needed, but this will not affect the rental rate.

There is a seperate entry to this unit located along the side pathway to the main doors. It has a large open living room with big windows and fantastic light during the day. There is a main closet, almost big enough to be a second bedroom or more likely to store sports equipment for an easy load in/load out. The kitchen is smallish, but serves its purpose, and has a space off to the side if you needed more, or it could be a perfect dining area, a work space, a craft space, or whatever else you can think of. The bedroom has a queen bed with enough space to still comfortably move about, and the closet is as large as the front one. I am almost wanting to call it a walk in but it does not have the right set up for that. Being an independently owned building you can modify it to something that suits your needs. The bathroom is easily large enough for two people to get ready in the morning, but a word of caution, the ceiling in the shower is a bit lower. You would have to be, I would say, 5'11" and under, unless you like to take a bath. There is one more good sized closet off the bathroom that can be used as a pantry, a linen closet, a cleaning supplies area or just a catch all. Although there is no actual on suite laundry, the back door to the unit opens dose into the laundry room so its almost as if its in your unit.

There is a parking spot available for rent in the rear of the building. It is electric baseboard heating. Rent dose not include electricity or internet.
